label: The Night cosmogony's bundle does not hold: no being in POTENCY_1 in a respect, to which no being…
paraphrase: The Night cosmogony's bundle does not hold: no being in potency in a respect, to which no being in act in that respect is simply prior, is being reduced to act in that respect (the negation of STMT-NIGHT-UNPRECEDED-POTENCY-ACTUALIZED). It does not deny the bare rival STMT-POTENCY-PRIOR-TO-ACT: an unpreceded potency that is never actualized is left open.
